video.title: I Built an AI Agent That Works While I Sleep (Cheap & Easy)

summary: Chris Koerner explains the difference between automations and AI agents. On camera, he builds a 'content multiplication' agent in n8n self-hosted on a Hostinger VPS that turns his latest YouTube transcript into short, medium and long LinkedIn posts with GPT-5. He warns about n8n cloud costs and pitches selling such agents to creators and businesses for $300-800/month plus a $2,000 setup fee, projecting $10-30k/month with 10-30 clients. The video is sponsored by Hostinger and the income figures are hypothetical.

ideas.name: Content multiplication agent service (YouTube to LinkedIn posts)
ideas.one_liner: Build n8n agents on a self-hosted Hostinger VPS that turn a creator's latest YouTube video transcript into short, medium and long LinkedIn posts, and sell setup plus monthly maintenance to creators and businesses.
ideas.business_model: Setup fee plus monthly retainer per client
ideas.customer: Creators, podcasters and business owners overwhelmed by social media (real estate, fitness, restaurants, health care)
ideas.problem: Repurposing long-form content into social posts takes time
ideas.offer: Daily scheduled agent: fetch newest video, pull transcript via youtube-transcript.io, extract 3-5 insights with GPT-5, write three LinkedIn posts in a set tone

pricing.notes: Chris's hypothetical: 10 clients = ~$5k/month; with setups up to ~$20k/month.

acquisition_channels.details: Build for friends for free first, use the first client as a case study to get the next three.

quote.text: Your first client is your case study and helps you get your next three clients
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.delivery: n8n self-hosted on a Hostinger KVM 2 VPS; YouTube API, youtube-transcript.io API, OpenAI API; VA after 5-10 clients.

acquisition.how: Starts with friends and referrals; selling to businesses needs human sales. UK cold email allowed only to limited companies (PECR); inbound content and templates better.

onboarding.how: Credential connection per client needs some hand-holding.

delivery.how: Scheduled agent runs unattended; posts may need approval.

support.how: Fixing broken workflows needs a human or a VA.

uk_applicability.notes: Works the same in the UK.

risks: Competition from other agencies and SaaS repurposing tools

tactics.name: Self-host n8n on Hostinger
steps: Choose Hostinger self-hosted n8n, KVM 2 plan, 12 months
Set password and owner account (~5 minutes)
Use templates library or build workflows

tactics.name: YouTube-to-LinkedIn workflow
steps: YouTube node: get latest video by date from channel ID
HTTP POST to youtube-transcript.io with Basic auth header and video ID
Three OpenAI nodes: short (<300 chars, hook <120 chars on two lines), medium (800-1,200), long (1,200-1,500); spartan tone, no emojis
Check each node pulls from the insights node

quote.text: Write in a spartan tone of voice. That helps these LLMs not just go off the rails
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Agency ramp
steps: Ask them to pay for more agents
Use first client as case study

warnings.warning: Cloud pricing trap: hosted n8n costs balloon with active automations; self-host instead.

quote.text: beware of what I call the cloud pricing trap
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Agents need good prompting and break sometimes; nodes must reference the right inputs.

quote.text: Yes, it needs good prompting, it needs good direction, and it might break sometimes
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Don't try to learn hardware and software at once with a Raspberry Pi.

quote.text: you can try to learn hardware and software at the same time. Don't do that
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Most viewers will do nothing; execution is the bottleneck.

quote.text: Most people are just going to watch this and do nothing
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Automations follow fixed rules; agents interpret and decide, enabling multi-step work like inbox triage.
Self-hosting open-source tools gives flat costs regardless of agent count.

quote.text: That way it's the same price for 10 agents or 100 agents with unlimited usage
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Constrain LLM output with explicit lengths, tone and no-emoji rules.
Start with free builds for friends to get case studies.
Template libraries let you avoid building from scratch.
Most competitors aren't using AI yet, so you can deliver as good or better for less.
